environment.project_dependency_declaration: CuPy is not declared in pyproject.toml or requirements files
environment.environment_only_installation: cupy-cuda12x 14.2.0 in the local virtual environment

project_probe.fallback_contract: CPU path is selected when CuPy is unavailable or when the GPU path raises

microbenchmark.purpose: Compare the existing X-Ray GPU path, including transfers, with the existing CPU implementation
microbenchmark.input: deterministic uint8 array generated from arange modulo 256; mode 1

observed_conclusion.editor_viewport_hotspot: QGraphicsScene rebuild/painting and structural refresh; not demonstrated to be CuPy-bound
observed_conclusion.portable_build_policy: keep excludes=[cupy, cupyx] and deterministic CPU fallback

limitations: This is not the official editor performance matrix and does not establish a frame-time budget.
Only the existing X-Ray kernel was measured; the parallax viewport path has no GPU counter in the current contract.
The local GPU environment is not a supported deployment baseline for all users, CI agents, or portable builds.
No dependency, package, source, schema, or runtime behavior was changed by this diagnostic.
reexecution_rule: Reexecute only if the CuPy integration, X-Ray implementation, supported-kernel performance contract, deployment/CI matrix, or portable packaging policy changes; unrelated UI, localization, documentation, or asset changes do not justify rerunning it.
